HxResult HxScrollbarDelete ( HxScrollbar_t *  pScrollbar  ) 

Delete a scrollbar widget.

This function deletes a scrollbar created from an earlier call to HxScrollbarNew.

It is not necessary to call this function when quitting the application, since the widget's parent calls this function just before the parent is deleted.

Parameters:
pScrollbar IN: Pointer to the scrollbar to delete
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.

HxResult HxScrollbarNew ( uint32_t  id,
HxWidget_t *  pParent,
HxScrollbarAttributes_t  attributes,
int32_t  fullRange,
int32_t  visibleRange,
HxScrollbar_t **  hScrollbar 
)

Create a scrollbar widget.

This function creates a new scrollbar widget.

The fullRange and visibleRange arguments are used by the system to calculate a ratio, which is used to determine where to draw the thumb of the scrollbar when the user moves the scroll wheel or presses the scroll arrow. fullRange is an arbitrary number representing the total size of scrollbable data, while visibleRange is a value proportional to fullRange that represents the visible data.

Parameters:
id IN: Unique ID for the widget, defined by app, or kHxWidgetAutoID to auto-generate the ID
pParent IN: Pointer to "parent" widget containing scrollbar
attributes IN: Attributes defining properties of the scrollbar, including orientation.
fullRange IN: Full range of the scrollbar
visibleRange IN: Visible range of the scrollbar
hScrollbar OUT: Handle to the created scrollbar, NULL on failure
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful. Returns HX_MEMORY_ERROR if memory allocation fails. Returns HX_INVALID_ARG if fullRange or visibleRange <= 0.

HxResult HxScrollbarSetButtonStep ( HxScrollbar_t *  pScrollbar,
int32_t  newStep,
int32_t *  pOldStep 
)

Set the button step size.

This function sets the number of pixels to scroll when arrow buttons are pressed or held.

Parameters:
pScrollbar IN: Pointer to the scrollbar
newStep IN: New step size, in pixels. Pass kScrollbarUseDefaultStep to use a default step size.
pOldStep OUT: Pointer to receive the old step size Pass NULL if you don't care about the old value.
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.
